qrcode.js — qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licence (header in the file).
The UMD wrapper is replaced by an ES export; UTF-8 is the default encoding.
models/u2netp.onnx — U²-Net (small, "u2netp") by Xuebin Qin et al., Apache License 2.0
  (https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net). ONNX export from rembg
  (https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases). Used by js/aibg.js for
  background removal in the browser. The runtime, onnxruntime-web 1.20.1 (MIT),
  loads from cdn.jsdelivr.net on first use.
